name: delegate
displayName: Delegate: Agents Sized to the Job
description: Your Claude Code session leads a team of agents, each on the cheapest model that can do its job. Work isn't accepted until a command proves it, and a built-in report shows where your tokens went.

minSeconds.title: Toast after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Show a toast when a subagent ends only if it ran at least this long; 0 shows one for every subagent.

cap.title: Agents at once
cap.description: The cap in the band's 'n/cap running' count. DELEGATE_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS, when set, takes its place.

collapseAbove.title: Collapse the band above (agents)
collapseAbove.description: With more running or recent agents than this, the band starts as one summary line; 0 always starts collapsed. A press of its button holds until no agent is left.
